symbols.name: recursion parameter
symbols.meaning: The recursion parameter: the number of field digits for address interchange, or of selected axes for a numerical layer.
symbols.quote: Here the letter $f$ changes meaning: it is the recursion parameter, the number of field digits for address interchange or of selected axes for a numerical layer, a stage of the arithmetic that works along chosen axes of the data.

relations.quote: Rank-saving recursion is realized by a [subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md) on three-element subsets.
Rank-saving recursion is instantiated by [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), where the parameter $f$ counts field digits.
